scope: One physical ASSY wrapper around the accepted system→LRU→SRU local chain; business events and reports equal accepted parent.
limits: The ASSY is visible in the physical connection path only; its lack of demand/stock/repair is bounded to this one wrapper and seed.
The direct system-to-LRU ItemReplacement row is added with the wrapper, so the run does not isolate whether that row was necessary.
No other ASSY placement, branches, quantities, repair levels, GUI rendering or cross-engine parity.
